title: VIKSIT GRAM PANCHAYAT PLAN
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Rural Development

VIKSIT GRAM PANCHAYAT PLAN

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
28 JUL 2026 6:27PM by PIB Delhi

Under
Section 16
 of the
Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB–G RAM G Act, 2025
, every
Gram Panchayat
 is required to prepare a
Viksit Gram Panchayat Plan (VGPP)
 through a participatory planning process. The Gram Sabha identifies and prioritises the permissible works required for the holistic development of the Gram Panchayat, and the Gram Panchayat prepares the VGPP in accordance with the provisions of the Act. The approved VGPP is thereafter consolidated at the Intermediate and District Panchayat levels for preparation of the aggregate Block and District Plans under the Mission.
Yuktdhara
 is a
GIS-based planning support tool
 that assists authorised functionaries in scientific planning by providing geospatial information and analytical inputs for the identification, prioritisation and planning of permissible works, thereby supporting the preparation of the VGPP. Access to the Yuktdhara portal is provided to authorised functionaries designated by the respective State Governments/Union Territory Administrations in accordance with the prescribed operational framework.

As per
Section 21
 of the
Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB–G RAM G Act, 2025
, the
State Government
 is responsible for providing the necessary staff and technical support, including
Rozgar Sahayaks
 and
Computer Operators
, to the
District Programme Coordinator
 and the
Programme Officer
 for the effective implementation of the Programme. These matters such as the manner by which the rozgar sahayaks and computer operators work fall within the administrative domain of the respective States/Union Territories.

The Ministry accords high priority to capacity building of all stakeholders for effective implementation of VB–G RAM G. Training programmes are being organised at the National, State, District, Block and Gram Panchayat levels through a cascading training framework covering the preparation of Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans (VGPPs), technology-enabled planning and monitoring tools including use of Yuktdhara. Detailed training modules, user manuals, standard operating procedures and digital learning resources like e-Saksham have also been made available with the States/Union Territories to facilitate effective implementation and strengthen participatory planning through Gram Sabhas. Also, Capacity Building is an ongoing process and as per the needs and requirements of the States/UTs the technical tram send by the Ministry to the respective States/UTs.

Under the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB–G RAM G, Mates engaged under the Scheme are paid wages at the semi-skilled wage rate, as notified by the respective State Government/Union Territory Administration in accordance with the applicable wage notifications. The wage rates payable to Mates are determined by the respective State Governments/Union Territory Administrations.

This information was given by the Minister of State for Rural Development
SHRI KAMLESH PASWAN
 in a written reply in Lok Sabha today.
